Portrait of Fernando Cervantes Jr.

Despite a slight improvement in the polls for President Donald Trump, his approval rating continues to hover near record lows in a new survey released by The Economist/YouGov on Aug. 25.

The poll found that 36% of Americans approved of Trump’s performance, a 1 percentage point improvement from last week’s The Economist/YouGov poll. President Donald Trump’s job approval rating in Alabama remains above water, though it has declined from the high point he reached at the start of his second term, according to the latest tracking data from Civiqs.

The survey shows 53% of Alabama voters approve of Trump’s job performance, while 40% disapprove. Another 8% said they neither approve nor disapprove. [...] The latest figures mark a modest improvement from early July, when 52% of Alabama voters approved of Trump’s job performance, 41% disapproved and 7% were unsure or held no opinion.

However, Trump’s standing remains below where it was at the beginning of his second term.
